scope: Primary public documentation; announced dates are not per-condition first-paid-fee timestamps.

observations: Builder fees are additive flat percentages of notional, separate from platform fees.
Default builder rates are zero; documented limits are 100 bps taker and 50 bps maker.
OrderFilled includes the signed builder code. A nonzero code alone does not establish a nonzero fee profile.
Historical builder profiles were not fetched. Four observed excess taker charges are compatible with additive builder fees under separately truncated five-decimal components.
March 30, 2026 Fee Structure V2 entry includes Weather among fee-enabled categories.
March 31, 2026 REST API Fee Fields Update directs fee calculations to the market feeSchedule object.
April 28, 2026 CLOB V2 production migration follows an April 17 announcement of match-time fees and removal of feeRateBps from signed orders.
September 4, 2026 introduces Data API v2; v1 remains frozen. No September weather-fee activation is listed in the observed changelog.
Weather coefficient is 0.05, maker fee is zero, maker rebate percentage is 25%.
Fee formula is shares times coefficient times price times one minus price; the 100-share weather table peaks at 1.25 at price 0.50.
The documentation describes five-decimal fee precision. Actual transaction comparisons retain rounding differences.
feesEnabled identifies current activation; feeSchedule carries rate, exponent, takerOnly and rebateRate.
takerOnly=true means the maker is not charged. These fields do not establish historical activation timestamps.
Weather rebates use fee-curve weights and a 25% allocation of collected taker fees.
Eligibility requires filled maker liquidity; allocation is per market, with daily pUSD payment and a one-pUSD accrued rebate minimum.
A configured rebate allocation does not prove an individual maker's payment.
Trade schema has no fee or rebate property. Absence must not be coerced to zero.
Event/condition trade queries ignore start/end bounds; timestamp filtering is local in this study.
taker_only defaults to true; false includes maker-side rows.
